exposure: Hereditary thrombophilia (Factor V Leiden, prothrombin G20210A, FXIII deficiency)
cohort: 268 multiparous women with a history of at least one placenta-related obstetric complication (PROC) or poor gestational outcome
finding: While the study did not find an association between PAI-1 genotypes and the frequency of having risk factors for PROCs, it did observe an association between MTHFR polymorphisms and the PAI 4G/4G genotype, and between hereditary thrombophilia and the PAI 5G/5G genotype.
